主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES, INC. filed a Form 8-K on February 1, 2012, to disclose that it plans to mail its quarterly financial information for the fourth quarter of 2011 to shareholders on or about February 6, 2012. The filing includes a copy of the mailing as Exhibit 99.1. The information in the report is not deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, except as expressly set forth. The report also includes a financial release dated January 31, 2012, covering the financial results as of December 31, 2011. The report was signed by Gregory J. Dawson, the Chief Financial Officer of the company.
